Require its supplying declarations and hypothesis instantiations in evidence; do not demand the named algebraic-closure object be definitional equal to the catalogue separable-closure object.

Ordinary intrinsic structure (the object Krull topology, profiniteness and natural maps) is included here. New Galois-correspondence/open-subgroup/index/quotient endpoints are excluded. Whole-file mapping qualification and proof prerequisite closure are different: a selected file may use a substantial imported theorem without automatically allocating the entire prerequisite file to this concept.
